app.name: mGBA-GX
app.long_description:
mGBAGX is a Wii frontend based on Visual Boy Advance GX utilizing the mGBA emulator core.
Features: • High compatibility emulation via mGBA • Wii-friendly GX interface • SD, USB support • Save states and battery saves • Controller support including Wii Remote, Classic Controller and GameCube Controller
Based on VBA GX by Tantric. Powered by mGBA by endrift and contributors.
